reviews.text: Hi, we visited a few months ago with our newly arrived cockatiel, and the service from arrival to departure was fantastic. Friendly and professional, they explained everything clearly. And I can assure you the price was great. I highly recommend them!
They're always excellent. I take my cat, whom I adopted through them, and they're very helpful in both critical and routine situations. Thank you.
Thanks a lot
Excellent service 😊 …
One of the best vet clinic I’ve ever visited. They took great care of our rats. Edgar is an artist when it comes to stitches. They provide services in English.
I didn't have an appointment, but when they saw what was wrong with my little bird, they gave me an appointment right away. Very kind.
Thank you so much
Dr. Edgard and his entire team are undoubtedly professionals with extraordinary human qualities, which in my case I value greatly when they attend to my pet.
Excellent service and professionalism. Highly recommended.
Excellent service!!

This is, by far, the best veterinary clinic I've ever taken my pets to. Edgar and his entire team are wonderful people, highly professional, with excellent facilities, and very reasonable prices.
My experience with them has always been positive, and whenever I've had a problem, they've been dedicated to resolving it and have helped me with great empathy.
If you need a veterinary clinic, or if you're not entirely happy with your current one, Vivaria never disappoints.
Thank you for your great work and for taking such good care of my furry friends.

The best veterinarian in all of Valencia. Honesty and professionalism from all the staff at the clinic. Accurate diagnoses and great care for the animals and their owners. Affordable prices and thorough treatments. Highly recommended.
We went to get our cat neutered! Great service, very fast, good attention.

I met Edgar, Luz, and Marian after adopting my kitten from them, and I couldn't be more grateful. They've been incredibly kind and explained in detail the care and nutrition my little one needs to grow strong and healthy. They're an extraordinary team, very professional, and with a genuine love for animal welfare. Highly recommended!
If you have exotic animals, this is the place for you.

Although my Kakariki sadly passed away due to a health issue, the care she received from Edgar and his intern was incredibly good. Edgar is a fantastic professional and explains absolutely everything. From the first time we went, we were delighted with his service. I highly recommend him, and since I have a Chihuahua, I will continue to go to his clinic. Thank you, Edgar, for your dedication to Sky ♥️
Kind and helpful staff!

Good afternoon, my name is Esther Costa from Mislata. I went to the clinic on May 16th with my lovebird, which was in terrible condition, practically dead. Thanks to Edgar, it's alive.

He's a fantastic veterinarian. Speechless. ❤
The entire clinic staff treated me wonderfully, and the service was simply amazing.
She is a professional and compassionate person with all animals. She also explains everything your pets might be suffering from and is effective and very efficient.
Thank you

I'm delighted with the wonderful care my dog ​​Macu and I received from everyone at Vivaria. Edgar is a fantastic veterinarian, Marian always treats Macu with so much love, and Luz is always incredibly kind and has a big smile.
I highly recommend them.

Edgar is an amazing veterinarian. He speaks English, which is helpful when discussing complicated issues.  As my dogs have been getting older, they are needing more care. I am sure they are getting the best care in Valencia! He is thorough. He is compassionate. He is the best veterinarian my puppies have ever had.

From day one, they've been the best clinic I've ever been to. They saved my dog ​​Odin's life so many times. And even though he's no longer with us, we'll continue to take our dogs and cats there. They've always done everything possible to make sure they're okay and have always treated us with great empathy.
Thank you so much
I should have gone with them earlier.

I am so incredibly grateful. I took my parakeet in with a huge cyst on her cloaca. They've given her a new lease on life; she's been doing wonderfully from the very first minute. Thank you, thank you so much. They are truly professional.

The service was adequate and the staff friendly, but I left quite confused by the information they gave me about rabbits. I went directly to ask about spaying my rabbit, assuming—because that's what I understood—that it was recommended. However, during the consultation, they told me that it wasn't necessary to spay a female rabbit and that if you adopt a male, you wouldn't need to spay the female. That same day, my partner and I, confused, wanted to ask Edgar for more information, and he said he would call us back, but he never did. I left there months ago thinking that it really wasn't necessary to spay her. Over time, after researching further and consulting with veterinarians specializing in exotic animals, I realized that it's quite the opposite, since spaying is highly recommended for female rabbits, among other things because of the high risk of uterine cancer. For that reason, I decided not to continue using the clinic. I'm sharing my experience so that other rabbit owners can be well-informed and compare opinions before making decisions.
Always very good service, excellent professionals.
Thank you so much

I have no words to express my gratitude for the humane and professional treatment we received. We brought our 13-year-old dog, Tobias, in with a huge tumor on his spleen, and Edgar was with us from the very first moment, calm, clear, and empathetic. He explained every step, all the possibilities, the good and the bad, without hiding anything but also without taking away our hope.

During the surgery, he treated Tobias as if he were his own dog, and the result was perfect. Tobias came out strong and stable and went home happy, eating and wagging his tail. His experience, dedication, and genuine love for animals were evident.

Vivaria is not just a veterinary clinic; it's a place where animals are family.

Thank you, Edgar, and your entire wonderful team for giving us back our companion and for caring for him with such heartfelt dedication.
